context.en: The Ming portrait commemorates Sun Bin, the strategist whose arrival in Qi is the subject of this entry.
context.zh: 明代画像纪念此条所述来到齐国的军师孙膑。

context.en: Sun Bin is the strategist named in the account of Guiling. This Ming portrait belongs to his later commemoration, rather than the battle.
context.zh: 孙膑是桂陵之战叙述中的军师；这幅明代像属于后世纪念，而非战役图像。

context.en: The 1609 book image identifies Qu Yuan, whose warning to King Huai is central to this account.
context.zh: 1609年刊本中的图像标识屈原，此条叙述以他对楚怀王的劝谏为重要内容。

context.en: A nineteenth-century depiction of Qin Shi Huang, the ruler who commissioned the Lingqu Canal.
context.zh: 这幅19世纪画像表现下令修筑灵渠的秦始皇。

context.en: The nineteenth-century portrait represents Qin Shi Huang, whose search for immortality frames the account of Xu Fu’s mission.
context.zh: 这幅十九世纪肖像表现秦始皇；此条关于徐福出海的叙述围绕皇帝求仙展开。

context.en: The later album names Han Xin beside Xiao He. Here it introduces the general whose early life at Huaiyin the entry recounts.
context.zh: 后世像册将韩信与萧何并列；此处用以介绍条目所述早年生活在淮阴的韩信。

context.en: Han Xin, named in this later paired portrait with Xiao He, commanded the campaign against Wei described here.
context.zh: 这幅后世双人像中题名的韩信，是此条伐魏战事的统帅；旁列人物为萧何。

context.en: The later album supplies a named image of Han Xin, commander in the Wei River account, rather than a reconstruction of the river battle.
context.zh: 后世像册提供潍水战事统帅韩信的题名像，而非对河战场面的复原。

context.en: Xiao He appears alongside Han Xin in this later album. This entry follows Xiao He’s role in building Weiyang Palace.
context.zh: 萧何在这部后世像册中与韩信并列；此条讲述萧何营建未央宫的角色。

context.en: The retrospective imperial image identifies Liu Xiu, whose campaign at Handan forms the second part of this entry.
context.zh: 这幅回顾性的帝王像标识刘秀；此条后半部分讲述其邯郸战事。

context.en: The later Thirteen Emperors image represents Liu Xiu, the ruler leading the Longyou campaign described here.
context.zh: 后世《历代帝王图》中的刘秀像，表现此条所述亲征陇右的统治者。

context.en: The Ming standing portrait commemorates Ban Chao, the envoy and commander whose Western Regions mission is the subject here.
context.zh: 明代立像纪念班超，此条的主题正是他的西域使节与军事活动。

context.en: This Ming image represents Ban Chao, whose dealings with Khotan’s ruler are recounted here.
context.zh: 这幅明代画像表现班超；此条记述他与于阗国王的交涉。

context.en: The Ming portrait presents Ban Chao, leader of the Shanshan mission described in this story.
context.zh: 明代画像表现班超，即鄯善使节故事中的领队。

context.en: The Ming portrait recalls Ban Chao, the protector-general at the center of this account of the Yanqi campaign.
context.zh: 明代画像追忆班超，他是此条焉耆战事叙述中的西域都护。

context.en: The Ming book image commemorates Cao Cao, the commander and poet named in the account of the Wuhuan expedition and Gazing on the Blue Sea.
context.zh: 明代书中图像纪念曹操，此条把他的乌桓战事与《观沧海》创作联系起来。

context.en: This Ming portrait presents Zhuge Liang, who led the southern expedition discussed here.
context.zh: 这幅明代画像表现此处南征叙述中的统帅诸葛亮。

context.en: The later imperial scroll portrays Yang Jian, the regent named in this account of the suppression of Yuchi Jiong.
context.zh: 后世帝王手卷表现杨坚，即此条镇压尉迟迥叙述中的辅政者。

context.en: The retrospective imperial likeness represents Yang Guang, the ruler killed in the Jiangdu coup described here.
context.zh: 这幅回顾性帝王像表现杨广，即此条江都兵变中被杀的统治者。

context.en: Guo Ziyi, at right in this later album, is the commander named in the entry’s account of recovering Chang’an in 757.
context.zh: 后世像册右侧为郭子仪；此条在叙述757年收复长安时点名这位统帅。

context.en: The right-hand portrait commemorates Guo Ziyi, whose support for Suzong at Lingwu is the subject of this entry.
context.zh: 右侧肖像纪念郭子仪，此条讲述他在灵武支持肃宗的行动。

context.en: The later album celebrates Guo Ziyi’s service. It accompanies the account of his negotiation with Uyghur forces, rather than depicting that meeting.
context.zh: 后世像册称颂郭子仪的功业；此处配合其与回纥军交涉的叙述，画面并未描绘该会面。

context.en: The later portrait of Han Yu introduces the prefect whose actions concerning bonded people and education are discussed here.
context.zh: 后世韩愈像介绍此条所述处理质押人口、兴办教育的地方官。

context.en: The genealogy’s later image identifies Shen Kuo, the writer whose account preserves the description of Bi Sheng’s movable type.
context.zh: 族谱中的后世像标识沈括；毕昇活字制作的叙述通过他的文字得以保存。

context.en: This later commemorative portrait identifies Shen Kuo, whose description of Bi Sheng is a specific example of craft knowledge transmitted through books in this story.
context.zh: 这幅后世纪念像标识沈括；故事以他对毕昇的记述为例，说明工艺知识如何经书籍传承。

context.en: The portrait added to Sima Guang’s appointment document identifies the minister recalled during the reversal of Wang Anshi’s reforms.
context.zh: 附加于司马光告身的肖像标识这位在废改王安石新法时被起用的大臣。

context.en: A Ming portrait of Yue Fei in official robes, accompanying the account of his northern campaign from Ezhou.
context.zh: 明代画像中的岳飞身穿官服，可与他从鄂州出发北伐的故事对读。

context.en: The later traveler-like portrait of Lu You connects with this entry’s account of his official service and poetic life in Sichuan.
context.zh: 这幅带有行旅形象的后世陆游像，与条目所述四川任职及诗歌生活相联系。

context.en: The imperial album identifies Kublai, the ruler who established the Zongzhiyuan discussed here. Its precise painting date remains unestablished.
context.zh: 帝王像册标识此条设立总制院的统治者忽必烈；画像的确切创作年代尚未确定。

context.en: Kublai’s imperial album portrait introduces the ruler who built and named Dadu.
context.zh: 忽必烈的帝王册像呈现了营建、定名大都的统治者。

context.en: The album portrait identifies Kublai, who led the campaign against Nayan named in this entry.
context.zh: 像册中的肖像标识忽必烈，即此条讨伐乃颜叙述中的统治者。

context.en: The 1829 book portrait commemorates Wen Tianxiang, whose recruitment at Ganzhou is the focus of this entry.
context.zh: 1829年图传纪念文天祥，此条以他在赣州募兵为主题。

context.en: The later portrait identifies Wen Tianxiang, one of the Song ministers named in the account of the court at Fuzhou.
context.zh: 后世肖像标识文天祥，他是此条福州朝廷叙述中点名的宋臣之一。

context.en: The 1829 portrait remembers Wen Tianxiang, whose detention and escape at Jingkou the entry recounts.
context.zh: 1829年肖像追忆文天祥，此条讲述他被扣押及在京口脱险的经历。

context.en: This 1829 commemorative portrait represents Wen Tianxiang, the captive poet named in the Lingdingyang account.
context.zh: 这幅1829年纪念像表现文天祥，即零丁洋叙述中的被俘诗人。

context.en: The Qing portrait commemorates Yu Qian, whose defensive preparations after the Tumu crisis are discussed here.
context.zh: 清代画像纪念于谦，此条讲述土木危机后的防御准备。

context.en: This later portrait identifies Yu Qian, the war minister central to the account of Beijing’s defense in 1449.
context.zh: 这幅后世肖像标识于谦，他是1449年北京防御叙述中的关键兵部尚书。

context.en: The later portrait commemorates Yu Qian, whose execution forms part of this account of the restoration of Yingzong.
context.zh: 后世画像纪念于谦；此条英宗复辟叙述也包含他被处死的事件。

context.en: The 1699 reading portrait presents Kangxi as a learned ruler, complementing this entry on his earlier visit and calligraphy at Qufu.
context.zh: 1699年读书像表现康熙的儒学修养，与此条较早的曲阜礼拜及题字活动相呼应。

context.en: The 1699 court portrait presents Kangxi, who ordered the Albazin operations. The siege itself was conducted by his commanders.
context.zh: 1699年宫廷肖像表现下令进行雅克萨军事行动的康熙；围城战由其将领执行。

context.en: The 1699 portrait identifies Kangxi, the emperor who attended the Dolon Nor assembly discussed here.
context.zh: 1699年肖像标识康熙，即此条亲赴多伦诺尔会盟的皇帝。

context.en: Yongzheng’s court portrait introduces the emperor who empowered Ortai in the administrative changes described here.
context.zh: 雍正宫廷像介绍此条委任鄂尔泰推行行政改制的皇帝。

context.en: The 1736 court portrait identifies Qianlong, the emperor whose 1757 restriction of Western shipping to Guangzhou is discussed here.
context.zh: 1736年宫廷像标识乾隆，即此条1757年限定西洋商船前往广州的皇帝。

context.en: Painted in 1736 near the start of his reign, this portrait shows Qianlong decades before the abdication discussed here.
context.zh: 这幅1736年统治初期的画像表现乾隆，早于此条所述禅位数十年。

context.en: The nineteenth- or early-twentieth-century portrait identifies Xiang Yu, whose removal of Emperor Yi is the focus here.
context.zh: 这幅十九至二十世纪初的画像标识项羽，此条主题为他对义帝的处置。

context.en: The later portrait represents Xiang Yu, one of the two leaders named in the Hong Canal agreement described here.
context.zh: 后世肖像表现项羽，即此条鸿沟议和中点名的两位领袖之一。

context.en: The 1609 Sancai Tuhui image commemorates Fan Zhongyan, the official associated with the coastal dike work described here.
context.zh: 1609年《三才图会》画像纪念范仲淹，即此条海堰工程所述官员。

context.en: This Ming book portrait identifies Fan Zhongyan, the reforming official at the center of the Qingli policy proposals discussed here.
context.zh: 这幅明代书中肖像标识范仲淹，即此条庆历改革建议的核心官员。

context.en: The 1875 photograph shows Zuo Zongtang after the 1864 Hangzhou campaign and restoration work discussed here.
context.zh: 1875年照片表现左宗棠，拍摄时间晚于此条所述1864年杭州战事与恢复工作。

context.en: Zuo Zongtang’s 1875 photograph identifies the commander associated here with Suzhou in Gansu and roadside planting.
context.zh: 左宗棠的1875年照片标识此条甘肃肃州战事与沿途植树叙述中的统帅。
